items.title: National CineMedia Announces 2026 U.S. Young Lions Winners
items.summary: National CineMedia (NASDAQ: NCMI) (NCM), the largest cinema advertising platform in the US, and the U.S. Representative of the Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity, today announced the five winning teams of the 2026 U.S. Young Lions competition. The winning teams were named and honored by NCM on April 22, 2026, at the TEAM USA Winners Announcement event, with all finalist teams in attendance.

items.title: National CineMedia Names Bernadette McCabe Vice President, Exhibitor Relations
items.summary: National CineMedia (NASDAQ:NCMI) (“NCM”), the largest cinema advertising platform in the US, today announced Bernadette McCabe as Vice President, Exhibitor Relations for NCM and Spotlight, effective May 5, 2026. McCabe will succeed Jennifer Lupo, who will retire from the Company on May 4, 2026. McCabe and Lupo will continue to work closely to ensure a seamless transition for the Company’s partners.

items.title: National CineMedia Announces Top 25 US Young Lions Competition Finalist Teams
items.summary: National CineMedia (NASDAQ: NCMI), the US Representative of the Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity, has announced the Top 25 finalist teams for the 2026 US Young Lions Competition. This year's brief challenged competitors to reimagine fundraising efforts for nonprofit partner Save The Music, engaging a new generation of music lovers. Finalists span five categories: Digital, Film, Media, PR, and Print.

items.title: VideoAmp Adds Data From SiriusXM, National CineMedia to Audience Planning Tool
items.summary: National CineMedia is now integrated into VideoAmp's cross-platform media planning technology, marking the first time cinema has been included in a unified planning solution of this type. The integration enables advertisers to plan campaigns across streaming, CTV, digital video, audio, and cinema environments within a single framework, bringing NCM's moviegoer data from 17,000 screens across 1,300 theaters in 184 markets into cross-platform planning.

items.title: National CineMedia and TransUnion Partner to Bring Cinema into Cross-Channel Attribution
items.summary: National CineMedia (NCM) and TransUnion have partnered to integrate NCM’s theatrical exposure data into TransUnion’s cross platform attribution solution. The collaboration gives advertisers full-funnel, data-driven visibility into how cinema ads drive performance alongside digital, CTV, social and other channels.

items.title: National CineMedia, Inc. Announces Strategic Acquisition of Spotlight Cinema Networks to Enhance Advertising Network and Expand Reach Among Luxury Audiences
items.summary: National CineMedia, Inc. announced the strategic acquisition of Spotlight Cinema Networks, adding high‑scale luxury cinema inventory, increasing national market share by ~6% and expanding presence in key New York and Los Angeles markets by 30%. This move strengthens NCM’s platform for premium advertisers and aligns with its growth strategy for 2026 and beyond.

items.title: Creator Economy Evolution: The Box Office’s Next Big Star is Your Favorite YouTuber
items.summary: The creator economy has grown into a $250 billion force, shaping culture and driving influence far beyond YouTube and TikTok. But most creators are still stuck on small screens. Cinema offers what digital feeds can’t—scale, cultural impact, and unmatched attention. With box office audiences booming and ads delivering more attention than mobile, the big screen is the next stage for creators. For brands, it’s a chance to amplify reach, engage Gen Z, and deliver real results.

items.title: How ‘F1 The Movie’ took a page from the ‘Barbie’ marketing playbook
items.summary: These days, did a movie even come out if it wasn’t embedded in every corner of culture? Apple’s marketing for F1: The Movie echoed the immersive frenzy of Barbie—from out‑of‑home visuals and surprise Brad Pitt appearances to personalized iPhone push notifications. The campaign turned the film into a cultural event, uniting F1 fans and mainstream audiences months before opening.

items.title: Reaching the unreachable: Pharma marketing in the age of evolving media habits
items.summary: In this MM+M podcast episode, industry leaders explore how pharma marketers can effectively reach healthcare providers and patients in today’s fragmented media landscape. Featuring insights from National CineMedia (NCM), the discussion covers the challenges of regulatory compliance, audience targeting, and media strategy—highlighting how high-impact channels like cinema are delivering real engagement and measurable results.

items.title: National CineMedia Expands Programmatic Inventory Through New Partnership with Vistar Media
items.summary: National CineMedia partners with Vistar Media to expand programmatic access to cinema ad inventory, offering brands an efficient, data-driven way to reach engaged moviegoers on the big screen through Vistar’s SSP.

items.title: Are movies so back?
items.summary: A strong Memorial Day Weekend box office has analysts and marketers hoping for pre-pandemic levels of movie magic.

items.title: iSpot and NCM Partner to Track Theater Ad Performance
items.summary: NCM and iSpot announced in June that they’re expanding their partnership to provide the first-ever scaled, third-party measurement of in-theater ads, specifically those that run during trailers before a movie begins. For the first time, NCM will integrate its household-level exposure data with iSpot’s unified cross-platform and outcomes-based measurement solutions.

items.title: iSpot, NCM partnership
items.summary: National CineMedia, the largest cinema advertising platform in the US, and cross‑platform TV ad measurement company iSpot, have announced the companies are deepening their partnership – with independent, in‑cinema measurement of advertisements that appear in the trailers before movies begin. The deal marks NCM’s first integration of advertising information with a third‑party measurement provider…

items.title: iSpot and National CineMedia Partner to Provide First-of-its-Kind Cinema Measurement at Scale
items.summary: iSpot and National CineMedia have partnered to launch the first scaled measurement of cinema ads, enabling brands to track performance alongside TV, digital, and streaming. The integration provides real-time insights, including reach, frequency, and sales impact—positioning cinema as a measurable, outcomes-driven media channel.

items.title: National CineMedia Partners with Operative’s Suite of AI-Based Cloud Solutions
items.summary: National CineMedia is partnering with Operative to modernize its ad-sales operations using AI-powered cloud tools. The collaboration will enhance forecasting, speed up proposal workflows, and improve campaign performance across NCM’s nationwide cinema network.

items.title: Executives Tout Importance of Legacy Theatrical Business at DEG EnTech Confab
items.summary: Despite changing technology and the rise of streaming, industry leaders at DEG's EnTech Fest said movie theaters remain essential. National CineMedia’s Tom Lesinski noted cinema has outlasted formats like DVD, continuing to drive value. Lionsgate execs agreed theatrical releases are key to consumer perception and streaming success. While box office numbers haven’t fully recovered, the theatrical window has stabilized and remains a vital part of the entertainment business.
